## Simulations

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores()-1)  # Adjust to your CPU cores

root_length_values = seq(1, 2, length.out = 21)
root_no_values = 3*10^seq(3, 8, length.out = 21)
nitrogen_values = seq(0.1, 100, length.out = 21)

# Create all combinations first
sim_grid <- expand.grid(
  root_length = root_length_values,
  root_no = root_no_values,
  soil_nitrogen = nitrogen_values
)

all_results <- future_lapply(seq_len(nrow(sim_grid)), function(i) {
  
  rl <- sim_grid$root_length[i]
  rn <- sim_grid$root_no[i]
  n  <- sim_grid$soil_nitrogen[i]
  
  lho <- new(LifeHistoryOptimizer, param_file)
  lho$set_i_metFile(weather_file)
  lho$set_a_metFile(weather_file)
  lho$set_co2File("")
  lho$set_soil_nitrogen(n)
  lho$init()
  lho$root_override(rn, rl)
  
  # simulate all months at once if possible
  results <- lapply(years_seq, function(t) {
    tryCatch({
      lho$grow_for_dt(t, dt)
      state <- lho$get_state(t + dt)
      df_row <- as.data.frame(t(state))
      names(df_row) <- lho$get_header()
      df_row
    }, error = function(e) {
      setNames(as.data.frame(as.list(rep(NA, length(lho$get_header())))), lho$get_header())
    })
  })
  
  df <- do.call(rbind, results)
  df$date <- seq(as.Date(paste0(start_year, "-01-01")), as.Date(paste0(end_year, "-01-01")), by = "month")[1:nrow(df)]
  df$soil_nitrogen <- n
  df
})

# Combine parallel output
final_df <- do.call(rbind, all_results)
```

## Fitness

```{r}

final_df_no_na <- final_df[!is.na(final_df$root_length), ]

fitness <- function(costs, nitrogen) {
  out <- costs - nitrogen
  return(out)
}


final_df_no_na$fitness <- fitness(
  costs = final_df_no_na$total_mass + 
    final_df_no_na$rs + final_df_no_na$rr + final_df_no_na$rl +
    final_df_no_na$tl + final_df_no_na$tr,
  nitrogen = final_df_no_na$nitrogen_uptake
)

```

## Trade offs: Root traits

```{r}
# Subset

subset_df1 <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(root_length == 1.5) %>%
  filter(date == "1960-01-01")

subset_df2 <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(root_no == 3e5) %>%
  filter(date == "1960-01-01")

## Range

fitness_range <- range(
  c(subset_df1$fitness, subset_df2$fitness),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

## plots

# ---- Compute max lines for subset_df1 (fixed root length) ----
max_line_df1 <- subset_df1 %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(fitness, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- Compute max lines for subset_df2 (fixed root number) ----
max_line_df2 <- subset_df2 %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(fitness, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- Plot 1: Root Number Heatmap with max line ----
p1 <- ggplot(subset_df1, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no, fill = fitness)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_line(data = max_line_df1, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no), color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis", limits = fitness_range) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Number\nper Unit Crown Area (log)",
       fill = "Fitness") +
  pub_theme

# ---- Plot 2: Root Length Heatmap with max line ----
p2 <- ggplot(subset_df2, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length, fill = fitness)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_line(data = max_line_df2, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length), color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis", limits = fitness_range) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Length (mm)",
       fill = "Start Fitness") +
  pub_theme

# ---- Display plots ----
p1
p2
```

## Trajectory

```{r}
# Soil N values to plot
soilN_values <- nitrogen_values

# ---- Maximum-Fitness Root Number Trajectory (all ties) ----
trajectory_max_root_no <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(soil_nitrogen %in% soilN_values) %>%
  group_by(date, soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(fitness, with_ties = TRUE) %>%  # <- keep all tied maxima
  ungroup() %>%
  select(date, soil_nitrogen, root_no)

# ---- Maximum-Fitness Root Length Trajectory (all ties) ----
trajectory_max_root_length <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(soil_nitrogen %in% soilN_values) %>%
  group_by(date, soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(fitness, with_ties = TRUE) %>%  # <- keep all tied maxima
  ungroup() %>%
  select(date, soil_nitrogen, root_length)

# ---- Plot Root Number with ties ----
ggplot(trajectory_max_root_no, aes(x = date, y = root_no, color = factor(soil_nitrogen))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +  # show multiple maxima if they exist
  scale_y_log10(limits = root_no_range) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Maximum Root Number\nper Unit Crown Area (log)",
    color = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
    title = ""
  ) +
  pub_theme

# ---- Plot Root Length with ties ----
ggplot(trajectory_max_root_length, aes(x = date, y = root_length, color = factor(soil_nitrogen))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +  # show multiple maxima if they exist
  scale_y_continuous(limits = root_length_range) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Maximum Root Length (mm)",
    color = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
    title = ""
  ) +
  pub_theme
```

## mean

```{r}
mean_df <- final_df_no_na %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen, root_no, root_length) %>%
  summarise(
    fitness = mean(fitness, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean_subset_df1 <- mean_df %>%
  filter(abs(root_length - 1.5) < 1e-6)

mean_subset_df2 <- mean_df %>%
  filter(abs(root_no - 3e5) < 1e-6 * 3e5)

p1_mean <- ggplot(mean_subset_df1,
                  aes(x = soil_nitrogen,
                      y = root_no,
                      fill = fitness)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis",
                       limits = fitness_range_mean) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Number\nper Unit Crown Area (log)",
       fill = "Mean Fitness") +
  pub_theme

p2_mean <- ggplot(mean_subset_df2,
                  aes(x = soil_nitrogen,
                      y = root_length,
                      fill = fitness)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis",
                       limits = fitness_range_mean) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Length (mm)",
       fill = "Mean Fitness") +
  pub_theme

# Compute maximum fitness at each soil nitrogen
max_line_df2 <- mean_subset_df2 %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(fitness, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Compute maximum fitness at each soil nitrogen
max_line_df1 <- mean_subset_df1 %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(fitness, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

p1_mean + 
  geom_line(data = max_line_df1, 
            aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no), 
            color = "red", size = 1.2)

p2_mean + 
  geom_line(data = max_line_df2, 
            aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length), 
            color = "red", size = 1.2)

fitness_range_mean <- range(
  c(mean_subset_df1$fitness, mean_subset_df2$fitness),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

```

## Trade offs: Ectomycorrhizal biomass

```{r}
subset_df <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(root_length == 1.5, root_no == 3e5)

heatmap_ecm <- subset_df %>%
  mutate(
    bin_soilN = cut(soil_nitrogen, breaks = 50),
    bin_ecm   = cut(log10(ectomycorrhiza_mass), breaks = 50)
  ) %>%
  group_by(bin_soilN, bin_ecm) %>%
  summarise(
    fitness = mean(fitness, na.rm = TRUE),
    soil_nitrogen = mean(soil_nitrogen),
    ectomycorrhiza_mass = mean(ectomycorrhiza_mass),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(heatmap_ecm,
       aes(x = soil_nitrogen,
           y = ectomycorrhiza_mass,
           fill = fitness)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_log10() +   # log axis if biomass spans orders
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    x = "Soil Nitrogen (g N m⁻³)",
    y = "Ectomycorrhiza Biomass (kg)",
    fill = "Fitness"
  ) +
  pub_theme
```
